answer_sentences.text: No, a Tier 3 UCB cannot levy a 2% pre-payment charge on a Rs 40 lakh sanction, because loans up to ₹50 lakh are covered by the prohibition.
answer_sentences.quote: "A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh."

answer_sentences.text: The sanction letter’s 2% clause conflicts with the loan rule, even though the letter says, "Pre-payment charges: 2% of the amount prepaid."
